senses.def: A state of Nigeria in the South South geopolitical zone. Capital and largest city: Uyo.
a member of the Akwa'ala community in Baja California
a community of Native Americans who speak a Hokan language and live in Baja California
the Yuman language spoken by the Akwa'ala
Synonym of Paipai (“an indigenous people of Mexico”).
the Yuman language spoken by the Akwa'ala

A Mohawk territory at the triple point of the US state of New York and the Canadian provinces of Ontario and Quebec, lying astride the international boundary; jurisdictionally split between the St. Regis Mohawk Reservation in New York, the Akwesasne 59 in Ontario and the Akwesasne 15 in Quebec.
A Tupí–Guaraní dialect cluster spoken in Pará in western Brazil.
